svg.aria-label: Chart: pooled effect sizes for companion robots in older adults — loneliness SMD minus 0.59 and agitation SMD minus 0.32; negative means improvement
svg.text: What pooled studies say companion robots do — and do not do
Standardised mean differences (SMD). Negative values mean improvement. Bars show the pooled estimate; whiskers show the 95% confidence interval.
Loneliness improves in the pooled data; for depression and quality of life the pooled results were not statistically significant.
Data sources: Mehrabi & Ghezelbash (2025), The Gerontologist (loneliness); Abbott et al. (2019) systematic review of 19 studies (agitation).
Note: the loneliness meta-analysis found evidence of publication bias; trials run for weeks, not years.
